headline: Brazil Unemployment Rate Holds at Record Low 5.1% in October
summary: Brazil's unemployment rate stood at 5.1% in the quarter ending in October, matching the lowest level on record, while average real income rose 3.5% over the year to BRL 3,812.
why: Employment figures and real wage growth are primary indicators of labor market health and domestic consumer purchasing power.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Low unemployment and rising real incomes strengthen domestic demand and consumer spending resilience.
